title: Credit Hold customers can be moved off Credit Hold
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Credit Hold, with a $0.00 limit (other customers may hold Credit Hold too).
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-25 Held.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Credit Hold" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Select None".
  4. Type {Customer-A}'s name in "Search customers".
  5. Tick {Customer-A}.
  6. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  7. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  8. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from Credit Hold" opens.
  • Step 3: "0 selected" (every customer on the term is unticked, including those not in view).
  • Step 4: only {Customer-A} is listed.
  • Step 5: "1 selected".
  • Step 6: no $0 line shows.
  • Step 7: the toast "1 customer moved to Net 30." shows; every other Credit Hold customer stays on Credit Hold.
  • Step 8: Credit Terms reads Net 30 and Credit Limit is $0.00, editable.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-N3: “Inactive terms and Credit Hold are valid sources (Move Customers is how a shop empties a deactivated term). Inactive terms are never offered in "Move To".”
  • S4-E3: “Moving customers to COD or Credit Hold sets each moved customer's credit limit to $0 (S4-R16), whatever limit they had, and keeps the previous limit in each note (S4-R20). Moving customers off COD or Credit Hold to another term leaves their $0 limit as it is until someone enters a new one in Edit Customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
